results:
The search didn't return the Express Tribune article itself, but several sources point to 2016 as the year AKUH introduced the system.

- **April 2016 introduction:** A reprint of the hospital's April 11, 2016 announcement says AKUH became the first in Pakistan to bring in this brain surgery technology, and the only hospital outside North America with it. (Aga Khan University Hospital becomes the first to introduce advanced equipment for brain surgeries in Pakistan)
- **Acquisition date:** An AKDN media summary states that in April 2016, the Aga Khan University Karachi (Pakistan) (AKUH) acquired a neurorobotics exoscope and neuronavigation system. That same summary is credited to The Express Tribune, but its own date is 11 September 2017, so it is a later Express Tribune piece.
- **Hospital's own description:** AKUH's site says it was the first Teaching Hospital outside North America and the first in Pakistan to introduce the revolutionary "Neuro-Robotic Exoscope". It gives no date.
- **Usage since installation:** The AKDN summary reports that since the exoscope's installation at AKUH, over 250 operations have been performed.

- **Launch date:** A hospital announcement dated April 11, 2016 says AKUH is the only hospital outside North America with this system. A separate AKDN summary says the exoscope was acquired in April 2016 that provides advanced imaging facilities.
- **"First" claim:** The hospital describes itself as the first Teaching Hospital outside North America and the first in Pakistan to introduce the revolutionary "Neuro-Robotic Exoscope".

content.text:
**答案：2016 年**（可能性最大，但我没找到 Express Tribune 的原文，所以不能完全确认）。

依据：
- 医院 2016 年 4 月 11 日的公告称，AKUH 是巴基斯坦第一家引进这套脑外科设备的医院：[ismailimail.blog](https://ismailimail.blog/2016/04/11/aga-khan-university-hospital-becomes-the-first-to-introduce-advanced-equipment-for-brain-surgeries-in-pakistan)
- AKDN 的媒体摘要写明，AKUH 在 2016 年 4 月购入了神经机器人外视镜（exoscope）：[the.akdn](https://the.akdn/en/resources-media/whats-new/in-the-media/state-art-brain-surgery-technology-comes-akuh)
- AKUH 官网也称自己是巴基斯坦首家引进"Neuro-Robotic Exoscope"的医院，但没写日期：[hospitals.aku.edu](https://hospitals.aku.edu/pakistan/AboutUs/News/Pages/advanced-options-in-brain-surgery.aspx)

AKDN 上那篇署名 Express Tribune 的转载，页面日期是 2017 年 9 月 11 日。你问的那句话如果出自这一篇，年份就会是 2017。
